Keyless start and remote start technology add practical comfort, especially during winter months or when you need the cabin pre-cooled on hot days.

Climate control is dual-zone automatic, allowing driver and passenger to set individual temperatures. Automatic high-beam headlights reduce driver fatigue during night driving, while delay-off headlights provide illumination as you approach your destination. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading cargo effortless, and the split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs.

The 2024 K5 LXS offers straightforward, honest transportation with the technology and safety features that matter most. We invite you to schedule a time to see this vehicle and experience the quality and value it represents.

Experience driving a versatile and efficient sedan with this 2017 Chevrolet Cruze LS Auto, finished in striking Red Hot. With just over 107,000 miles, this used vehicle offers a reliable, stylish ride that balances performance with everyday practicality. Its sleek four-door body provides comfortable seating for five, making it an ideal choice for daily commuting or weekend getaways. Powered by a turbocharged 1.4L four-cylinder engine producing 153 horsepower and 177 lb-ft of torque, this Cruze delivers spirited acceleration while maintaining impressive fuel economy—30 mpg in the city and 40 mpg on the highway. The front-wheel-drive layout ensures confident handling, complemented by a smooth automatic transmission, making every drive effortless. Inside, the Jet Black interior combines comfort with modern convenience, featuring advanced technology like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth connectivity, and a Wi-Fi hotspot to keep you connected on the go. The vehicle’s backup camera enhances safety and ease of parking, while the touchscreen infotainment system and auxiliary inputs provide entertainment options for all passengers. This Chevrolet Cruze LS Auto is packed with features designed to enhance your driving experience. The 7-inch touchscreen display offers intuitive control over your entertainment and connectivity, including Pandora and Stitcher internet radio apps. Electronic messaging assistance with voice operation and a read function help you stay connected safely while on the move. For added convenience, the vehicle includes a USB port and auxiliary inputs compatible with iPod and iPhone devices. Its safety features prioritize your security, starting with a rear seat reminder and dual front knee airbags. The Cruze is equipped with four-wheel ABS and power door locks with anti-lockout capability, providing peace of mind during every trip. Additionally, a programmable safety key allows for personalized security settings, ensuring your vehicle remains protected when parked or unattended. 2017 Chevrolet Cruze Safety and Security Features The Cruze offers essential safety features, including a check rear seat reminder to prevent accidental leaving of rear passengers. Dual front knee airbags provide additional protection in a collision, while four-wheel ABS ensures optimal braking performance in various conditions. Power door locks with anti-lockout functionality add convenience and security, preventing lockouts and unauthorized access. The programmable safety key allows owners to customize security settings, offering peace of mind when parking or leaving the vehicle unattended. 2017 Chevrolet Cruze Entertainment and Technology Features Entertainment and connectivity are at the forefront with this Cruze, featuring a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment system that simplifies control of your audio and apps. The vehicle includes internet radio apps Pandora and Stitcher, enabling streaming entertainment on the go. Electronic messaging assistance with voice operation and a read function keep you connected safely, while auxiliary inputs—USB and iPod/iPhone—offer seamless device integration. The touch screen display ensures easy navigation through your entertainment options, making every drive more enjoyable. 2017 Chevrolet Cruze Performance Features The Cruze’s performance is enhanced by auto start/stop technology, which helps improve fuel efficiency by shutting off the engine during idle periods and restarting seamlessly when needed. This feature supports economical driving without sacrificing responsiveness, making it an excellent choice for daily commuting and long-distance travel alike.
